definitions.explanation: Refers to people, matters, or activities outside one's own company or organization. The opposite of 社内.

examples.japanese: {社外|しゃがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}らさないで→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't leak this outside the company.

examples.japanese: {社外|しゃがい}⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二|ふた}{名|めい}⟦{選任|せんにん}→選任：30646_sennin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社外|しゃがい}{秘|ひ}です⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い→取り扱い：09806_toriatsukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧ご⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This information is confidential to the company, so please handle it with care.

notes:
USAGE:
A common business term used as a prefix or standalone noun. Pairs with ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧ (inside the company). Often modifies other nouns directly without ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社外|しゃがい}{秘|ひ} (company confidential)
- {社外|しゃがい}⟦{取締役|とりしまりやく}→取締役：12124_torishimariyaku⟧ (outside director)
- {社外|しゃがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (someone outside the company)
- {社外|しゃがい}{向|む}け (for external use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧: inside the company — the antonym
- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧: external — a broader term not limited to companies
